rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Implements the Open Trust Registry (OTR) protocol for merchant trust verification. Provides tools to verify merchant trustworthiness through a 7-dimension scoring engine covering identity, technical security, compliance, policy, web presence, data quality, and fulfillment. Includes a 10-layer anti-fraud engine with deterministic, reproducible scores backed by immutable audit trails.
